description: The report. Runs the check exactly as ec2_section_check and writes the plugin's calculation sheet (.xlsx in the CS 455 reference format, EN 1992 content, live formulas): one sheet per section - geometry, materials, reinforcement (and tendons with P_m0 / P_m,inf), section properties, and the governing row of each check printed in full (sagging and hogging bending, shear, torsion, SLS stresses, crack width; prestressed / composite: transfer, stage stresses, interface shear, decompression) - plus a Summary sheet with demand, resistance and ratio per check. Returns a download link. Use the same inputs that ec2_describe_section confirmed against the user's drawing. Read-only on the model.

cases.description: Combinations (or load cases) by name, optionally with the limit state. Default: every readable combination with the limit state read from its name / CIVIL NX type (frequent ones only when a section is prestressed).

elements.description: Beam elements to check ('101to104 201' or a list). Default: every element of the listed sections.

maxRows.description: Stop above this many distinct force sets (default 2000).

screen.description: Check only the governing candidates (force extremes per section and limit state) instead of every row.

sections.description: One entry per section to check, with its reinforcement (and psc for a prestressed beam).

grade.description: EN 206 class, e.g. C35/45 (default: from the model material, else C30/37 assumed).

links.description: Shear links (omit for no links: members without shear reinforcement, EC2 6.2.2).

member.description: Check as a column, pier or pile (EC2 5.8 slenderness, imperfections, nominal-curvature second order; pile: bored-pile minimum steel 9.8.5) instead of a beam. Default: column when the elements are mostly vertical, else beam. Effective length l0 = k * length about each axis: caseY/caseZ from EC2 Fig 5.7 (a pinned both ends 1.0, b cantilever 2.0, c fixed-pinned 0.7, d fixed both 0.5, e fixed both, sway 1.0, f fixed-pinned, sway 2.0) or kY/kZ.

length.description: metres (default: the longest run of joined elements with this section)

phiEf.description: effective creep ratio (5.8.4), default from the engine

uncased.description: pile: bored without casing (EC2 2.3.4.2(2) reduced diameter)

psc.description: Prestressed beam (EC2 5.10, 6.1, 7.1-7.3; 6.2.5 interface shear when composite): every tendon at its own position. tendons: the plugin's text lines - 'y z Ap [sigma_pm0]' for one tendon, 'y1 z1 y2 z2 n Ap [sigma_pm0]' for a line of n - with Ap in mm² or a strand '15.7s' or '19x15.7', coordinates mm from the datum (bc = bottom centre, bl = bottom left, tc = top centre, z down); or a list [{y, z, area, sigma0?}]. Stage 1 (prestress, girder self-weight, load cases tagged stage1) acts on the girder alone; give composite for a precast girder + deck slab.

slab.description: the section's deck-slab region (default when it has one) or everything above a depth

rebar.description: The bar schedule, as the plugin's Reinforcement tab: cover (mm to the bar face, default 40), gap (mm between layers, default max(25, Ø)), rows [{face: bottom|top|side|depth, layer (1 = nearest the face), count ('6' bars or '@150' spacing), dia (mm), depth (mm below the top, face 'depth'), which (side bars: both|left|right), span/from/to}], coords {datum: bc|bl|tc, text: 'y z dia' per line, mm}.

settings.description: The plugin's Loads > Settings (defaults as the window).

wkPsc.description: bonded tendons crack width limit mm (0.2)

sheetSections.description: Sections to give a sheet (default every checked section).

stages.description: Prestressed sections: load case name -> girder (self-weight at transfer and on the girder), stage1 (on the precast girder, e.g. wet slab), ps (the model's own prestress case: removed, the tendons carry it), comp (composite, default). PS-type cases default to ps.

stations.description: Stations along each element (default all five).

name: ec2_export_calc_sheet
title: Eurocode Section Checker: calculation sheet (Excel)
